title: OMCA evidence ledger, version 1
description: The live ledger .omca/evidence/verification-evidence.json and each monthly archive beside it. It describes what the writer emits. A reader keeps unknown keys and skips an entry it cannot read, so neither level forbids additional properties.

version.description: Always written first by the writer. A file without it reads as version 1.

type.description: The kind of run. Only a final_verification entry with a task_id can close a run's final task.

command.description: The command that ran, cut to 2,000 characters.

exit_code.description: The command's real exit code. For final_verification, 0 records COMPLETE.

timestamp.description: UTC at seconds precision, such as 2026-10-02T12:05:00Z.

verified_by.description: The agent or person that verified, cut to 200 characters. Absent when logged empty.

task_id.description: The id of the native task a final_verification entry closes. Absent when logged empty.

tree.description: Tree hash of the working directory when the entry was logged, written by the server. Absent outside a git repository or when git could not produce it.
